data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2020 were $16.2896m and increased to $58.696m at 31 December 2020. Calculating the change in gross claims liabilities by underwriting year shows a net prioryear adverse movement of approximately $15.733m (strengthening), driven primarily by adverse claims development including impacts from the COVID19 pandemic; this movement is derived from the technical provisions (per underwriting year) rather than an explicit narrative figure in the report.
raw_causal_phrases: impacted by adverse claims experience arising from the COVID-19 global pandemic.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross prioryear movement sentence was found. The prior-year movement (15.7329m) was calculated from the technical provisions table by summing endof-year gross claims liabilities for prior underwriting years (2018 + 2019) and subtracting the opening total claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2020. This is a calculated figure (confidence 0.8). There is no full claims development triangle presented that would allow a diagonal comparison; if reinsurance-to-close or other adjustments affected the per-underwriting-year totals, the computed PYD could be distorted. Figures are reported in the native currency of the accounts (USD).
